The workflows are on `action_required` (fork gate) — could a maintainer press "Approve and run workflows"?

Local verification while waiting: `bundle exec rake test` (2522 runs, 8534 assertions, 0 failures), `bundle exec rake internal_investigation` (142 files, no offenses), `bundle exec ruby -Ilib -Itest test/project_test.rb` (changelog format, 18 runs, 0 failures).

Thanks for tracking this down. The bug is real, but I went with a different fix.

Skipping the outer correction regresses autocorrection: RuboCop's correction loop already recovers from the clobbering, so master reaches `_(_(a).must_equal(b)).must_equal(c)`, while this stops at `_(a).must_equal(b).must_equal(c)` and leaves an offense `rubocop -a` can never clean up. It also misses `_(a.must_equal(b)).must_equal(c)` under `EnforcedStyle: expect`, since `matcher_call?` does not match `_(...)`.

Instead of replacing the whole receiver, #367 replaces only the DSL method selector and uses `corrector.wrap` for the new calls, so the ranges nest instead of overlapping. Opened with you as a co-author, thanks again for the feedback!
